none.title: Add an emergency contact first
none.loggedOut: Log in and add someone you trust so you can call them or send your location.

sms.choose: How would you like to get help?
sms.draftReady: SMS draft ready. Review it and press Send in Messages.
sms.sharingNote: Keep this screen open and return after sending. Location updates can pause while Messages is open or your phone is locked. Sharing expires after 30 minutes.
sms.costNote: Your mobile plan’s SMS charges may apply. The recipient can open the tracking link in a browser.

errors.account: Log in with a real account to share your location.
errors.location: Location is unavailable. Enable location services and allow SafeStep to access your location. You can still use Call.
errors.network: Location sharing could not be updated. Check your connection; the recipient may only see the last received position.
errors.composer: The SMS app could not be opened. Try Open SMS draft again, or press and hold the preview to copy the message.
errors.stop: Updates have stopped on this device, but the server could not confirm ending the link. Try Stop sharing again; otherwise the link expires automatically.
errors.expired: Location sharing has expired. Choose Send location to create a new SMS and tracking link.
errors.configuration: Location sharing is unavailable. The app needs a backend and a web tracking address.
